_note: SYNTHETIC telemetry, invented for benchmark use. Not a real production sample.
definition: Republishes per document after its first publish, and the share of reads each group receives.
hot_set_definition: The 21-200 and 201+ buckets combined: 8000 documents, 0.8% of the corpus.
notes: Reads are spread across the whole corpus, not concentrated on the republished documents: 61% of reads target documents that are never republished after first publish.
The hot set is small and its members are republished repeatedly within the same hour.
